digest.component_or_area: metrics adapters — claude transcript mining backfill
propositions: An optional isolated adapter mines Claude Code transcript JSONL to extract environment/integration failure history via deterministic error-signature grep and keyword-based classification (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none), never invoking an LLM or external service.
The adapter is quarantined behind a backfill script and never imported by the core metrics command, preserving portability of the main harness.
Every classified record is labeled with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to signal low-confidence backfill origin and segregate it from authoritative structural metrics.

The normative routing table maps error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, timed out, git/ruff/mypy/pytest errors, etc.) to the classification enum via case-insensitive substring/regex matching (first match wins).

Unit tests verify deterministic classification of fixture transcripts, assert zero output for clean transcripts, confirm core metrics modules do not import the adapter, and exercise the backfill script entry point; no LLM or network call occurs.
